body.zh: 带上备选方案、已有证据和个人约束，先检查预填的问题。
body.en: Bring your options, evidence and constraints, then review the prefilled question before starting.

question.zh: 帮我比较这些事项，想清楚应该做什么、停什么。
question.en: Help me compare these initiatives and decide what to pursue or stop.

body.zh: 先准备相关材料，打开助手后检查预填内容，再按发送开始。
body.en: Bring the relevant material, review the prefilled request in the assistant, then send it when ready.

prompt.zh: 帮我准备下一次一对一，先看上次的关切和承诺。
prompt.en: Help me prepare my next one-to-one using previous concerns and commitments.

title.en: Set up a Monday decision list

body.zh: 先查看时间、读取工具、结果去向和单次预算；确认并启用后才运行。
body.en: Review the schedule, reading tools, destination and per-run budget. The task runs only after you confirm and enable it.
